reviews.x: Perfect. Very breathable. Probably doesn’t filter anything, but it looks good and you won’t get kicked out of Costco.
Though I disagree with having to wear one, this one is the best. Lightweight and breathable. By far my favorite!

Best mask ever! So breathable, even during my Pilates classes, when other masks were just so suffocating. Definitely will stick with these types of masks from now on and believe me, I’ve tried them all!

reviews.t: Good enough if I have to wear it
reviews.x: I loathe wearing masks, but these are ok. 4 stars for thickness (or thinness, better yet). If I have to wear a mask, I prefer thin masks and these are very breathable. The shape/fit does allow them to move too much while talking, so I have to adjust often. They are lightweight, but not well crafted - I had small pieces of the material on my face on numerous occasions. Not a big deal. They're good to have in the car for when I forget my preferred mask.
Extremely thin and very breathable! I like how lightweight they are. I would recommend.
Exactly as described super comfortable Highly recommend!

I'm mad I didn't buy this kind of mask sooner, but maybe I was hoping the madness would stop. Here we are a year later. These are so so thin, very soft, and very breathable. I just ordered more colors for me and my kid. I only wear masks when forced and it kills me that my kid has to wear one all day at school. Usually I cut the extra layers out of the cotton ones, but it is still too hot and makes me feel like I'm smothering. These are great. Highly recommend.

I got these to wear to TPC so I wouldn't get yelled at and they are the most breathable I've found. Other than the black, the colors are pretty feminine so I couldn't really share with my husband, but still a great purchase. I used to wear the cute Kitsch masks but they are soo thick. These are wonderful in comparison to other masks out there. They also sit a little looser on my face so I don't feel like it rubs my make-up off quite as much.
Very nice natural, nice prints but too big for a woman face.

reviews.t: Not even close to what's pictured
reviews.x: The picture shows the mask dipping down under the eye area, it does not.  As a matter of fact I cannot tell which end is up.  As a result, it does not fit well either way and obscures the bottom of your vision.  Breathability is terrible and it's just basically ill fitting cloth.  Don't believe the hype!  All of the "top ten" websites out there say this is a good mask to buy, it is not.

Perfect for those of us who don't actually care about masking and just need to be able to live our lives. The masks are extremely thin and breathable. They are a little large if you have a smaller face but I just knotted mine behind the ears and now they're perfect. I have asthma and this is the first mask I've found that does not inhibit my breathing. Definitely recommend.

reviews.t: Best mask ever for picky wearers!  You must buy!!!!!
reviews.x: Love the masks!  Light weight and very easy to breath through.  My spouse is super picky and it’s the only mask that he will wear.  Thanks for the amazingly product.  We will be purchasing more of these as the pandemic continues.  Superior quality! Great color choices, great selection and awesome pricing.

These are thin, only one layer but comfortable to wear in Texas heat. Also it does not fog my glasses while wearing.  Giving it 3 stars cos the size is a little big for me, maybe should have different sizes or adjustable at the ear

Masks are very thin and comfortable. They do not irritate the ears at all because of the lightweight material. Great for the price and anticipate the fabric will fray over time, as expected at this purchase price.
Theses are the only mask I will wear. They are comfortable and breathable. So glad I ordered them as I have to wear a mask every day.
It’s a little large for me, but it’s the best kind of mask that I have ever had. Don’t irritate the skin and it’s easy to breathe.
Love that it's breathable and comfortable.  Only downside is that they're a little loose so I wish they were more fitted.
This mask is totally worthless. I washed it and it separated. It has not even been used yet. Waste of money.

These masks were lightweight but still felt like I had a layer of protection. I had tried many other types of masks and was looking for one that wouldn’t cause sweat, fogging of my glasses and most importantly I didn’t want to feel like I was breathing in fibers of the masks. I became really sensitive to cotton type materials and they would cause breathing difficulties and coughing. This mask fulfilled everything I was looking for and fit my budget. My son also started using them while playing s

Great for vacations where you still need to wear masks. Not protective, though. We wear them inside to restaurants and on the streets. We have protective ones but these are great, light and fancy for all the places you go that really are in relaxed atmospheres. They last for about twelve wearing. They will wear out through washing faster as they fray but for the money you have several so they are a great value.

These are perfect for the gym!! They're very thin, so be aware of that if you're looking for a thick mask because these are not it.  I specifically bought these for the gym because I cannot work out in a mask to save my life. These are perfect and very comfortable! Also super easy to wash which is a plus. 1000% recommend if you want some thin masks!

I got these for my husband who still has to wear a mask at work as well as an extra package to use for a long flight hoping they would be pretty breathable. I will say that I am concerned that the airlines won't allow us to use these since they aren't double layer so that was kind of a waste but I do like how light and breathable they are.

Got these per the reviews, looking for the thinnest mask I can find to satisfy the public. I've been sweating in various masks this past year and am finally returning to work. Need something about the thickness of a hair to get thru the day.  These are a no go. Not sure of the material, but its spongy and still too thick.

Do masks do any good? who knows (there are "facts" that support both sides) but if you are going to wear one for large periods of time, or during periods of activity, these are lightweight and comfortable. They seem pretty durable as well.  (purchased the 2nd set since the first set was light colors, this set was black)

They are a tad big but then again I have a small head. I think they are the most comfortable of any mask I’ve purchased so far. The seam is a little funny because it’s on the outside, but I’d rather have it there and not scratching my face so I’m ok with it. A good buy for as many as you get.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the masks as very breathable and lightweight.
Many reviewers find the masks thin, soft, and comfortable to wear.
Several reviewers say the masks run large or fit poorly, especially for smaller faces.
Some reviewers note the masks are good value for the price.
A few reviewers mention the masks move around or are not well crafted.
